values.note: Dodge County: electric sites $30 a night (rate effective 2026-01-01), non-electric $20, group site $100; first two tents included, each further tent $15; $6 reservation fee, non-refundable; cancellations 7+ days ahead refunded less that fee. Read 2026-11-16.

values.note: Premier Campground online booking, or the county parks office by phone. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

note: Dodge County park on the historic Danville Mill Pond of the Crawfish River, ~3 mi east of Columbus; the river splits the park, and the main entrance is on County Road TT. Numbered sites are electric, lettered sites are not (most of the lettered ones at the Point, the park's north tip). Sites 1-13 line the Crawfish River and 15-23 the mill pond, behind a band of trees. --Claude
summary: Dodge County pages confirm 60 sites (45 electric with 50 A at some, 14 non-electric, 1 group), $30 electric / $20 non-electric, $6 reservation fee, showers, flush + vault toilets, potable water, dump; Premier booking confirms the Apr 15-Oct 31 camping season. Riverview kept. Pin sits at the east-side trails entrance across the river: move ~420 m to the camping loops. Note drops 'Point tent-only' (map shows lettered non-electric campsites there) and 'limited winter camping' (Premier: camping season Apr 15-Oct 31, day use year-round).
flags: PIN MOVE ~420 m: stored 43.3261,-88.9476 is the Bridge & Trails entrance on County Road T, east of the river; camping loops (sites 24-53, between the north river row 1-13 and the mill-pond row 15-23) at ~43.3262,-88.9528. The county's posted park coordinate 43.32567,-88.95617 is the main entrance/office on CTH TT.

Waterfront riverview kept: sites 1-13 run along the Crawfish River (~70 m wide) and 15-23 along Danville Mill Pond, each behind a band of bank trees on Esri imagery (sites 1-13 around 43.3268,-88.9550; 15-23 around 43.3225,-88.9535); no site is on open ground within ~50 m of the water.

Note claims dropped: 'Point tent-only' (the county map labels the Point's sites as lettered non-electric campsites, nothing about tents only) and 'limited winter camping' (Premier: 'Camping Season - April 15th through October 31st. Day use throughout the year.'). 'Reservable online up to 1 yr ahead' is not stated on any county page; left out of the booking fields and the note.
